inlineImageAndParagraph.text: Phonetic Name Matching is an advanced API that verifies identities by identifying names that sound similar, even with significant spelling discrepancies, typos, or diverse regional transliterations. It leverages sophisticated algorithms to convert names into phonetic codes, drastically improving the accuracy of identity verification and reducing false negatives in critical processes like KYC and onboarding.

items.description: Names are processed using advanced phonetic algorithms like Soundex, Metaphone, and Double Metaphone, converting them into standardized phonetic codes for robust comparison, irrespective of spelling variations.

The generated phonetic codes are then intelligently compared against target names. This process identifies high-probability matches that might otherwise be missed due to common misspellings or data entry errors.

Users can define specific matching thresholds to control the sensitivity of the comparison. This allows businesses to tailor the API's behavior to their unique risk appetite and operational requirements, ensuring optimal accuracy.
